lead.claim: Structured rehab with PRP improves short-term pain and function in subacromial pain.
lead.context: Why this matters: A randomized controlled trial looked at adding a structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach to conventional physiotherapy for subacromial pain syndrome patients.

supporting.claim: What control strategies will make lower-extremity exoskeletons more effective?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This review explores how to improve control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons used in gait rehabilitation, addressing current limitations like unintuitive interfaces.

supporting.claim: Low-frequency deep brain stimulation may aid long-term orofacial recovery post-TBI.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A case study investigated if low-frequency deep brain stimulation could help a patient with chronic dysarthria and dysphagia after a traumatic brain injury.

supporting.claim: Digital health apps are good for prehabilitation and bridging rehab gaps for knee issues.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A qualitative study explored German patients' experiences with prescription-based digital health applications for knee disorders, focusing on their perceived benefits and challenges.

supporting.claim: New scales assess Myalgic Encephalomyelitis severity and occupational status.
supporting.context: Why this matters: Researchers developed and evaluated the Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS) for adults with ME/CFS.
